caption:
Not every straight line is proportional.

Proportional means y = kx: a constant ratio and a graph through (0, 0). A taxi charging $3 plus $2 per mile is linear, but not proportional.

Follow @samsonsatprep for daily SAT tips.
tiktok_caption: Linear isn't the same as proportional. Here's the quick test.

youtube.title: Proportional vs Linear: The Quick Test
youtube.description: A relationship is proportional when y/x is constant and the graph passes through the origin. A $3 starting fee makes C = 2m + 3 linear but not proportional.
